FIT_only.training: Only immutable original C35 public FIT 31 anchors/279 physically executed two-action forks; no C35 FIT_CHECK, C36 consumed worlds or outcomes fitted

contrast.factorialDesign: 2x2 exact same FIT conditional vs shuffled effect inputs, and with/without episodic observed inverse-turn-at-same-physical-pose veto; add equally FIT-trained conventional 2-step ridge with/without same veto, unchanged R3 and learned-FIT-motor goal heuristic
contrast.actualActions: All arms independently reset original source seed; every selected left/right/forward actually executed, original R3 graph updated on its own chosen public source before/after, goal, reward. After divergent action sequences there is no matched future-state claim.
contrast.goalHeuristic: Best of the original learned FIT source heading motor displacement vectors scored by publicly observed goal-Manhattan progress after a candidate turn plus forward; no hidden grid, future state, unused action outcomes or novel fitted weights
contrast.reverseTurnVetoDefinition: Before opposite-turn option, veto if last actually selected turn equals R3-proposed inverse turn at same observed public physical x,y; separately evaluate disabled condition
contrast.pendingForwardCommit: After selected opposite turn, attempt real forward on next step only if new public front unblocked, and abort otherwise
contrast.coldOS: For each real episode, serialize native R3 graph, source FIT model and episode-local prior chosen action/pose and pending option after third physically executed selected action; in a genuinely distinct OS verify next public choice exactly
